coverage_notes: No source series in the catalogue corresponds to prepaid expenses, prepayments, or accrued income. The Cash & BS items sheet contains only Cash at bank, Revolving credit facility, Term loan A, Accounts receivable, Stock/inventories, and Accounts payable — none of which represent prepaid expenses. The P&L and SaaS metrics sheets also contain no balance-sheet prepayment line. The data must be sourced directly from the management accounts or trial balance outside this model.

No source series in the catalogue represents net PP&E or tangible fixed assets. The available balance-sheet items cover cash, revolving credit, term loan, accounts receivable, inventories, and accounts payable — none of which correspond to property, plant and equipment net of accumulated depreciation. The fixed asset register or management accounts referenced in the template definition have not been provided as a source series.

No source series in the catalogue covers identifiable intangible assets (net of amortisation, excluding goodwill). The source sheets contain P&L items, cash/debt/working-capital balance sheet items, and SaaS metrics, but no fixed-asset register or intangibles schedule is present. The closest proxy — accumulated amortisation implicit in P&L!r16 (Depreciation & amortisation) — cannot reconstruct a net intangibles balance without a gross cost opening balance, which is also absent. Data must be sourced from the fixed asset register or management accounts balance sheet and added to the source catalogue.

No source series representing goodwill or any intangible/acquisition balance sheet item exists in the provided catalogue. The available balance sheet series cover only cash, revolving credit, term loan, accounts receivable, inventories, and accounts payable. Goodwill arising on acquisition must be sourced from the management accounts or statutory ledger and loaded separately.

No source series in the catalogue corresponds to accrued expenses / accruals / deferred income. The available balance-sheet items are Cash at bank, Revolving credit facility, Term loan A, Accounts receivable, Stock/inventories, and Accounts payable — none of which represents expenses incurred but not yet invoiced or paid. Additionally, the template requests monthly data for 2025-01..2025-12, whereas the Cash & BS items sheet only covers 2026-01..2026-12, so even a proxy series would not cover the required period. Data must be sourced directly from the management accounts or trial balance.

No Net Income, PBT, EBIT, or post-tax bottom-line series exists in the source catalogue. The P&L sheet contains revenue, cost, gross profit, opex, and EBITDA-level lines (r8–r16), but stops at 'Op. profit before depreciation' (r14); there is no interest expense, tax charge, or net income line. All P&L lines that could be combined to approximate net income (r14, r15, r16) are already allocated to other template lines and cannot be reused without double-counting. The metric cannot be populated from available source data.

No capital expenditure / CapEx series exists anywhere in the source catalogue. The P&L, Cash & BS items, and SaaS metrics sheets contain no series for purchases of property, plant and equipment or capitalised assets. The metric must be sourced directly from the management accounts / capex ledger and entered manually into the template.

No source series in the catalogue covers M&A cash flows (acquisition consideration paid or disposal proceeds received). The available series span P&L items, balance-sheet stocks, and SaaS KPIs; none represents net cash from business or asset acquisitions/disposals. The template slots (2025-01..2025-12) are noted as currently empty, consistent with no underlying data being present. This line must be populated from management accounts or M&A records outside the current source catalogue.

No source series in the catalogue covers cash dividends or equity distributions paid to shareholders. The P&L, Cash & BS items, and SaaS metrics sheets contain no line for dividend payments or shareholder distributions. This data must be sourced directly from management accounts or treasury records and entered manually into the template.

Cash & BS items!r6 is already allocated to another template line and likely represents drawn balance not total commitment. No source series in the catalogue explicitly captures the revolving credit facility commitment (maximum available line). True commitment size requires the loan agreement or a dedicated debt schedule series not present in the source data.

The source catalogue contains only one debt instrument series: 'Term loan A' (Cash & BS items!r7), which is already assigned to another template line. There is no Term Loan B series anywhere in the source data. The source catalogue has no debt schedule or management accounts data covering a second term loan tranche. This metric is genuinely unavailable from the provided source data.

No source series representing second lien debt exists in the catalogue. The available debt series are a revolving credit facility (Cash & BS items!r6) and a term loan A (Cash & BS items!r7), both of which are already assigned to other template lines and neither qualifies as second lien debt. The template specifies the source should be a debt schedule, but no such schedule or second-lien-specific series is present in the source data.

No mezzanine debt series exists in the source catalogue. The available debt instruments are Revolving credit facility (Cash & BS items!r6) and Term loan A (Cash & BS items!r7), both of which are already assigned to other template lines. There is no series representing mezzanine or subordinated/PIK debt. The source catalogue would need a dedicated mezzanine/debt-schedule series to populate this slot.

No source series in the catalogue represents capital/finance lease obligations or any lease liability balance. The available balance sheet items cover cash, revolving credit, term loan, accounts receivable, inventories, and accounts payable — none of which corresponds to finance lease liabilities. The data would need to come from a dedicated lease schedule or management accounts line not present in the source extract.

No source series in the catalogue corresponds to seller/vendor notes or deferred consideration. The available debt series are revolving credit facility (r6) and term loan A (r7), both already used by other template lines and neither representing seller notes. The SPA/debt schedule referenced as the authoritative source has not been provided as a source series.

The source catalogue contains two debt instruments already used by other template lines: 'Revolving credit facility' (Cash & BS items!r6) and 'Term loan A' (Cash & BS items!r7). No remaining source series represents any other interest-bearing debt instrument (e.g. subordinated notes, shareholder loans, finance leases, other term loans). The Cash & BS items sheet covers only those two debt lines plus cash, receivables, inventory, and payables. There is genuinely no series available to populate 'Other Debt'; the slot must remain empty pending a supplementary debt schedule from management.

No source series in the catalogue captures an interest rate or revolver rate. The available series cover P&L line items, balance sheet balances (including the revolving credit facility balance at Cash & BS items!r6, already used), SaaS metrics, and headcount — none of which represent the all-in interest rate (base + margin) applicable to the revolver. This data must be sourced directly from the loan agreement or rate schedule and entered manually.

No source series in the catalogue captures the all-in interest rate on Term Loan A. The source catalogue contains the Term Loan A outstanding balance (Cash & BS items!r7, already used) but no corresponding rate or interest expense series. The rate must be sourced directly from the loan agreement or rate schedule and entered manually into the template.

No Term Loan B interest rate series exists in the source catalogue. The source contains a Term Loan A balance series (Cash & BS items!r7) and a Revolving Credit Facility balance (Cash & BS items!r6), but neither carries an interest rate, and there is no TLB instrument or rate schedule data present at all. The all-in TLB rate must be sourced directly from the loan agreement or rate schedule and entered manually.

No net income line exists in the source catalogue. The P&L terminates at 'Op. profit before deprec' (r14) with one-off addbacks (r15) and depreciation (r16), yielding an EBIT-level figure at best. There are no interest expense, tax, or below-the-line items available to derive true net income. Computing net margin from EBIT would misrepresent the metric as defined (bottom-line net income ÷ revenue). Data is genuinely unavailable at the net income level.

FTE data (SaaS metrics!r7) covers only 2026-01..2026-06; template demands 2025-01..2025-12. Even if ratio computation were supported, there is zero period overlap between the FTE series and the template slots. The metric cannot be populated without either (a) a pre-computed source series or (b) 2025 FTE data being added to the workbook. SaaS metrics!r7 is labelled USD/money but values (~488–508) are clearly headcount counts — treat as dimensionless if used.

No source series for new hires or hiring activity exists in the catalogue. The only headcount-related series is SaaS metrics!r7 (Total employees FTE), which is a period-end stock of total headcount — it cannot be reliably decomposed into gross new hires because it reflects net change (hires minus attrition) and is already used by another template line. No HR/payroll system feed is present in the source catalogue.

No source series in the catalogue captures voluntary attrition (resignations only). The only headcount-related series is SaaS metrics!r7 (Total employees FTE), which is a stock/level measure and cannot be decomposed into voluntary vs. involuntary departures. No HR/payroll departure data exists in the source catalogue. Data must be sourced directly from the HR or payroll system.

No source series representing active customer count (or a close proxy such as logo count) exists in the provided catalogue. The available SaaS metrics cover ARR, FTE headcount, and logo churn rate — none of which is a customer count stock. The template specifies the source as CRM/billing system, which has not been surfaced in the source data extract.

No source series in the catalogue tracks new customer / new logo counts. The available SaaS metrics cover ARR (r6), total FTE headcount (r7), and logo churn rate (r8), none of which represent new customers acquired. The P&L and Cash & BS sheets contain no customer-count data. The template definition calls for data from a CRM or billing system, which has not been provided in the source catalogue.

No source series for churned customer count exists in the catalogue. The only churn-related series is SaaS metrics!r8 (logo churn rate as a monthly percentage), which is a rate not a count of churned customers, and it covers 2026-01..2026-06 rather than the required 2025-01..2025-12 window. Converting a churn rate to a customer count would require a total customer base series, which is also absent. The actual churned customer count must come from the CRM or billing system and has not been loaded into the source data.

ARR [SaaS metrics!r6] is a point-in-time stock but represents total ARR, not a cohort-level split between existing and new customers. No billing-system or cohort-level revenue retention series is present in the source catalogue. NRR must be sourced from billing/revenue analytics outside this model.
